name: Quantum Engraving #005 — Silicon Vapor Plume
description:
The vaporization horizon: beyond 3538 Kelvin, silicon atoms liberate from covalent metallic bonds into an expanding supersonic atomic vapor plume (Lv = 1.278 x 10^7 J/kg), exhibiting celestial luminescence, ethereal violet-blue ionization clouds, and nanoscale aerosol condensation hovering above the incandescent laser crater.

Conceptually derived from Master's Thesis research in Nanophotonics and numerical simulations in COMSOL Multiphysics ('Modeling and implementation of laser engraving considering the impact of layers material', University of Tabriz). This artwork visualizes phase vaporization kinetics and rapid gas expansion.

Note: This artwork is an artistic interpretation inspired by multiphysics simulations and theoretical models; it does not claim to be a raw numerical export.
creator: Alireza Mahdipour Shadkam
